question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**capacity**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence: “But everyone needs to work in some (3)_____.” requires a noun that means a role, function, or ability in which a person works.
 
• “**Capacity**” means ability, role, or function — it fits naturally: “work in some capacity.”
 
• Other options do not fit the meaning or collocate correctly with “work in”: “measurement”, “magnitude”, and “volume” are inappropriate here.
 
• So the most suitable choice for blank (3) is **capacity** (Option 4).

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Measurement **(माप): refers to quantifying size or amount — not suitable here.
 
• **Magnitude (**परिमाण): means size or extent — wrong sense for the sentence.
 
• **Volume **(पर‍िमाण/आयतन): usually refers to amount or quantity (or sound level) — does not collocate with “work in.”
